'''Varlo''' was a city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roonadan]].

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] visited this city in order to find out the location of [[Taun We/Legends|Taun We]].
